resources.string: Shows on the map the areas around you where the habitat suits this species best.
The map will highlight where %1$s is more likely around the chosen point, from the dominant trees, the soil and the orientation of the slopes.
%1$s is not in season this month: you are unlikely to find it now.
Indicative only. It needs an internet connection. Large circles are computed roughly; zoom in for more detail.
Your position is not known yet. Open the map, wait for the GPS fix and try again.
Choose a mushroom in the Mushrooms section and tap \"Where can I find it?\".
Indicative only: combines the trees (MFE25), the soil (IGME 1:1,000,000) and the orientation. Zoom in for more detail.
The place the main map is centred on now. Move the map first to search another area.
The map has not been shown yet. Open the map, move it to the area to search and try again.
The map will highlight the areas around the chosen point where any of the selected species is more likely: %1$s.
None of the selected species is in season this month: you are unlikely to find them now.
Marks the three places of the circle where more of the selected species could meet, and lets you walk to them.
Looking for the best spots for the selected mushrooms…
%1$d hotspot marks drawn on the map.
No place in the circle suits this selection well enough to be marked as a hotspot.
The hotspots could not be computed. Check the connection and try again.
